title: The Pump House

victory.note: The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Russians win.

situation: The pump house holds the water of the district. Assault engineers with a demolition charge and a flamethrower go in under smoke against a garrison that hides its strength. The Germans attack with 5 squads under 2 leaders and 2 support weapons. The Russians hold with 4 squads under 1 leader and 2 support weapons. The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Russians win. The Germans move first. 6 turns.
notes: A project scenario of the library, slot L02 (owner directive, 2026-10-16), not a printed scenario. `sl-cli library` made it from draw seed 3 and board seed 4. The rule level is 26. The defending force is 302 points and the attacking force is 534 points on the scale of slcampaign.points, a share of 7 to 4. No part of it is card text (SR-07). Balance (gate item 4, 2026-10-17): v7 against v7 gave the German attacker 750 of 1,600 games (46.9 percent), artifact runs/20261017T015828Z-library-l02-s1-10, with the necessary counters of the slot (2 assault engineer squads, 1 flamethrower, and 1 demolition charge). Gate item 3: v3, v6, and v7 played it to the end on the two sides. The owner accepted the card on 2026-10-17. The card names the victory building by its rank and its band of columns since 2026-10-17, because nothing on the board marks a building; that change is to the text only.
